capabilities: Load the formula at the cursor into a right-side Studio panel
Edit math with voice or typed commands
Apply edited LaTeX back into the note, replacing the original range in place
Strip and restore math delimiters ($, $$, \(, \[) around the edited content
Override the Studio URL for self-hosted deployments
disambiguation: Not voice-only; formulas can also be edited with typed commands.
extras: Install is manual (copy folder into .obsidian/plugins); no community plugin store install described. The Studio is embedded via a URL that can be pointed at a self-hosted deployment.
problem: Editing LaTeX math in Obsidian means manipulating raw delimiter-wrapped text in the editor, with no dedicated interface for composing or revising formulas.
summary: Side-panel Studio that loads LaTeX math from the editor and lets you edit formulas with voice or typed commands, writing changes back in place.
